heading: INT. BANK OF ARGENTÍ, LOBBY - MORNING

units.text: INT. BANK OF ARGENTÍ, LOBBY - MORNING
Marble floor, brass teller cages, a mural of cranes against a gold sky.
A grandfather clock ticks.
The room smells of floor wax and cold coffee.
INSPECTOR LENNOX HADDAD (50s, rumpled tweed, notebook) stands at the center of the lobby, looking up at the mural.
TELLER MARIBEL OSORIO-WYNN (30s, cardigan, lanyard) counts bills with an expert thumb.
A MAN IN A GRAY HOOD (40s, wiry, gloves) leans on the writing desk, apparently filling out a deposit slip.
The bank's manager, MR. THADDEUS PEMBROKE-ADEYEMI (60s, three-piece suit), polishes his monocle behind his desk.
Lovely cranes.
units.name: HADDAD

units.text: Painted in 1924. The artist never cashed his fee.
units.name: PEMBROKE-ADEYEMI

units.text: No?
units.name: HADDAD

units.text: ^He was paid in kind. He lived upstairs for a year.
units.name: MARIBEL

units.text: Quite so.
units.name: PEMBROKE-ADEYEMI

units.text: The man in the gray hood glances up.
Looks at the door.
Looks at Haddad.
Returns to his slip.
Sir, that's an interesting deposit slip. Third time you've started over.
units.name: HADDAD

units.text: The hood doesn't answer.
He tears the slip in half.
Pockets the pieces.
The clock ticks once, twice.
Maribel's thumb stops on a bill.
